title: MedThread context annotation row
description: Schema for the existing positive/context example CSV. This schema does not declare corpus-wide exhaustive entity coverage.

note_id.description: Unique source note identifier; patient identity is resolved from the synthetic notes manifest.

sentence.description: Source sentence or the smallest documented evidence span used for this label.

entity_normalized.description: Canonical target concept from the configured lexicon.

notes.description: Annotation rationale. Current benchmark rationale is present in this column.

future_exhaustive_annotation_fields.entity_start: Integer character offset in the original note; inclusive.
future_exhaustive_annotation_fields.entity_end: Integer character offset in the original note; exclusive.
future_exhaustive_annotation_fields.rationale: Annotator explanation; independent review and adjudication metadata should be recorded.
